task.intent: Plan the smallest actual-shot correction that makes her control of the galloping horse believable, while preserving accepted identity, action and staging. No universal hand rig or portrait reopening.

A contact correction may over-lock the arm and reintroduce stiff neck/shoulder performance or sleeve deformation.

obligations.action: Confirm scope and genuine Director decisions. No new spend, installs, specialists, publication or protected creative changes by inference. Routine in-scope technical fixes remain agent-owned. Astra is top tier; failed method needs reassessment, not a nonexistent higher model.

Read current strategy; name outcome, quality floor, interfaces, assumptions, earliest integrated proof, resources, reuse and replan/exit. Repeated compensating patches trigger method reassessment, not renamed passes.

Compare the complete claimed result to accepted references and required use, seeking known and new failures plus adjacent regressions. Actual motion/audio where applicable; distinguish frame inspection from playback. Tests, better-than-before and source hashes do not establish perceptual PASS. Known FAIL/NOT_RUN blocks handoff.

Write audience intent and distraction hypotheses before a defect list. Test them against actual evidence, seek counterevidence and unlisted problems, record observations and corrections. Director feedback calibrates fallible judgment; it is not the primary defect detector.

Meet the quality floor first. Then weigh visible benefit, dramatic value, reuse and regression/opportunity cost. Re-rank residuals after larger fixes. Prior tolerance is not acceptance. Record deferred details and reopening triggers; no arbitrary timer waives quality or creates handoff.

Bind actual inputs, accepted scope, source hashes and dependencies. Revalidate affected checks after camera/motion/version changes. Preserve originals and failed evidence. A local commit is not native-media backup; a reopened scene is not proof of portable or general reuse.

Track active effort, waits, jobs, actual provider spend and usable output separately; leave unavailable tokens/cost null. Do not add overlapping process/activity time. Diagnostic investment is not repeatable unit cost. Advance the trailer and two episodes, not tooling or polish for its own sake.

Compare accepted anatomical transitions with matched camera/scale/light. Separate clay, colour and lighting when diagnostic; preserve throat/clavicles, shoulder and hip volume across full/partial poses. Clothes cannot waive anatomy. Extend approved cheek character outward rather than flatten it.

Complete motion brief; establish transform spaces, evaluated parent state and one contact/travel owner. Test coordinated joints, transition interiors, neutral return and complete motion. Nonzero keys do not prove neck absorption, emotion or natural movement.

Rein grasp remains OPEN: inspect moving silhouette/enclosure, penetration/sliding, wrist/arm coordination and rein response at actual framing; include sleeve/shoulder regression controls. Preserve staging rather than hide defect. Credible required-shot grasp, not a universal hand rig, is the exit.

Keep at least two legible outer wraps and shawl above chest harness. Trace both edges across shoulders and outside rear headfall. Check support, moving contact and body-versus-cloth control before surface detail. Connectivity/clearance numbers alone do not qualify drape; single-wrap simplification is superseded.

Check hair/mane/tail/cloth/dust response coherently in actual motion; protect roots/supports and scale forcing by length. Dust needs world-space continuity through turns and contrast without obscuring action. New motion/camera/palette invalidates relevant checks; authored lag is not general physics.
